decision: Stop expanding minimum-subset selection/local regex attachment as a contribution. The selector has no observed independent role, free repair fixes the same visible errors, and neither update transfers to the pre-fixed source constructions. Preserve the single-pair latency/token signal without claiming general cost advantage. No DEV/main training/extra calls are justified to rescue this candidate.

post_hoc_no_selection_ablation.scope: Isolates selector only; does not refute acquisition from ordinary expressibility or erase measured acquisition cost.

primary_sources.verified_relevance: Already learns regex/Python rules and applies failure-driven updates with admission checks; generic patching is not a difference.
Existing core-predicate/condition/effect decomposition and empty effects for references were common hints to both arms, not our contribution.
Learns reusable syntactic transformations from examples using a DSL and ranking. Our finite selector is not a new general program-repair principle.
Formal constraints can guide neural synthesis. Our two natural-language source corrections are not a formal universal semantic oracle.
Structured latent alignments/abstract programs are a relevant tool, not evidence that our current regex patch learner acquires compositional semantic operators.

research_adjustment: Retain actual learned programs and common execution components; withdraw the assumption that adding constrained patch selection establishes a new legal learning contribution. Before another model experiment, a method must learn/combine semantic operators rather than memorize two clause constructions, and its same-information control must share the compact interface. This is a concrete design gap, not a requirement for universally correct parsing or a new dataset.

source_quotes: 2.5 The Recipient shall not be precluded from disclosing the Confidential Information that is (i) obtained by the Recipient without restriction from a third party who is not in breach of any obligation as to confidentiality to the owner of such Confidential Information or any other person, or (ii) disclosed by the Discloser to a third party without any obligation of confidentiality, or (iii) previously known by the Recipient, or (iv) at any time is developed by the Recipient completely independently of any disclosures hereunder.

source_semantic_findings.interpretation: The source says the Recipient shall not be precluded from disclosing information in the listed categories. The initial prohibition head reverses the scope of not over precluded. Neither learned update activates on this construction. Do not infer a whole-contract label or silently repair the output.

source_semantic_findings.interpretation: Clauses4(b-d) concern the existence of the Agreement/related discussions, whereas4(a) concerns Confidential Information. The initial compiler appends4(a) as context and emits additional share permissions without a represented information-object distinction. The existing4(a) permission can support some queries; this finding is not a claim that all native answers are wrong. No update activates.
